# Student Management System Guidelines

- Follow the C++17 standard for this console application.
- Use meaningful class, function, and variable names.
- Prefer standard C++ libraries.
- Follow RAII for resource management.
- Prefer smart pointers over owning raw pointers.
- Validate user input before using it.
- Avoid undefined behavior, memory leaks, and dangling pointers.
- When debugging, explain the root cause before suggesting a fix.
- Prefer minimal changes over unnecessary refactoring.
- Preserve existing application functionality.
- Recommend compilation and execution tests after every fix.
